summary: Clearmind Medicine, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a share purchase agreement entered August 31, 2026, to acquire 149 ordinary shares (51% fully diluted) of Israeli Charging Robotics for $2.5 million (about $16,778 per share). Closing is expected during the week of September 7, 2026, conditioned on a $1.5 million loan from Clearmind at 4.0% simple interest, due in three years with extension potential. The acquisition may be significant under Regulation S-X; historical and pro forma financials could follow. Risk-arb angle focuses on speedy closing and loan funding.
